page: OVHcloud l40s-90 is a GPU-accelerated server in the Cloud GPU family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 15 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz with a single thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 90.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, the server is equipped with a single NVIDIA L40S GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in large language model (LLM) inference tasks. The server achieves top 10% placement in prompt processing and text generation speeds across small (135M), medium (7B), and large (70B) models. CPU performance is strong in single-core stress-ng tests, placing in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average range.

Given the hardware profile, the l40s-90 is highly optimized for AI workloads, specifically LLM inference, machine learning model execution, and GPU-accelerated data science. The dedicated AMD EPYC cores and NVMe storage provide a balanced foundation for data ingestion, though the system is primarily tailored for GPU-bound tasks rather than general-purpose multi-core scaling or massive memory-intensive databases.
